description: The U.S. Department of State (DOS) is issuing this Request for Information (RFI)/Sources Sought Notice for market research in accordance with FAR Subpart 10.002(b)(2)(ii) and FAR Subpart 19.501 to gather industry input about the Agency�s requirement, contractor capabilities, and best practices regarding the Office of Security Management�s Administrative Support Division managing the Construction Security Monitoring Program, consisting of Top-Secret Construction Security *Team Leaders (TL), *Assistant Team Leaders (ATL), Cleared American Guards (CAGs), Construction Surveillance Technicians (CSTs), and *Site Security Coordinators (SSC), referred to herein as Site Security Personnel (SSP). *Personnel selected as Team Leaders, Assistant Team Leaders, and Site Security Coordinators will be derived from the base labor categories of CSTs and/or CAGs. DOS is specifically seeking to identify companies that have the skills and capabilities to support this effort, establish suggestions that industry may have to enhance efficiency and improve quality for the performance of these requirements. The DOS also seeks to understand any concerns that industry may have about this requirement. DISCLAIMER This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a Request for Quotation (RFQ), Invitation for Bid (IFB), Request for Proposal (RFP), or an obligation on the part of the Government to acquire any services. Responses to this RFI are not offers and will not be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract of any nature. The Government will not award a contract because of this notice. The Government does reserve the right to determine how it will proceed because of this notice. Your response will assist the Government in the development of its acquisition strategy for a possible Request for Proposal (RFP) which may be issued later. This notice will also help with determining whether any type of small business set-aside is possible for this procurement or whether full and open competitive procedures should be utilized. If full and open competition is ultimately pursued, responses to this synopsis will be used to aid in establishing small business subcontracting goals. Responding parties should not anticipate Government feedback on their respective submissions. The Government will not pay any cost incurred in response to this RFI. All costs associated with responding to this RFI will be solely at the responding party�s expense. It is the responsibility of the potential contractors to monitor the websites for any information that may pertain to this RFI or future solicitation. All information requested and received in response to this RFI will be treated as information only. The information provided in this RFI is subject to change and is not binding on the Government. DOS plans to review and meaningfully consider all responses to this RFI. Also, it must be advised that all submissions become Government property and will not be returned. Proprietary information and trade secrets, if any, should be minimized and must be clearly marked on all materials. Responses to this RFI may be reviewed by Government technical experts drawn from staff within DOS and/or by selected support contractor personnel. All Government and support contractors will be bound by appropriate non-disclosure agreements to protect proprietary and source selection information as described in 41 USC 423. The Government shall not be held liable for any damages incurred if proprietary information is not properly identified. GENERAL INFORMATION Current Contract Information: Incumbent contractors are currently providing construction security services at Department of State facilities abroad. This includes, but is not limited to, professional monitoring of uncleared labor, observation and note taking, reporting of all security violations, site access control, 24/7 presence, material inspection, document control, and assistance to the designated Site Security Manager(s). Contract Type: The Government contemplates award of either Labor Hours, Time and Material, Firm Fixed Price, or a combination of contract types. Estimated Contract Value: $250M Period of Performance: The period of performance of the contract is anticipated from March 15, 2027, through March 14, 2032, with a one (1)-year Base Period and four (4) one (1)-year Option Periods. NAICS Code: The anticipated North American Industry Code System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 561612, Security Guards and Patrol Services. PROGRAM DESCRIPTION The Department of State (DoS) requires the implementation of SSP to support operations at various overseas facilities designed to control unauthorized access to controlled areas, to deter the introduction of unauthorized materials to the compound, site, or building, and to surveil the activities of un-cleared construction workers to prevent the implantation of clandestine surveillance devices or systems into the structure or its surroundings. REQUIRED CAPABILITIES To be considered capable, interested sources must demonstrate the capability to meet all the following requirements set forth herein: Task 1.0 Recruitment of Personnel The contractor shall be capable of recruiting personnel qualified to obtain the necessary security clearance and having the minimal eligibility requirements for each labor category: Construction Surveillance Technicians must have at least five (5) years� experience in at least one, or a combination of construction security surveillance, technical surveillance countermeasures, industrial or government security involving counterintelligence, construction quality assurance, hands-on construction supervisory or significant construction experience, or Military Occupational Specialty (MOS) relating to any of the requirements. Cleared American Guards must have three years� experience as or like a Military Policeman, Marine Security Guard (MSG), or a security watch stander whose duties included the use of alarm systems, metal detectors, x-ray devices and closed-circuit television systems. Team Leaders and Site Security Coordinators must be approved by the CSM Program Office (COR). They will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis by regard to task order solicitation request and requirements. All personnel must be 21 years of age and older. Task 1.1 Personnel Capabilities All personnel must be in adequate physical and mental health; validated by a licensed physician, and be capable of working within construction sites that include, but are not limited to experiencing: hazardous air quality without personal protective equipment (PPE), standing and walking for extended periods of time, navigating terrain that may present the need to climb, withstand slippery conditions, capable of ascending/descending scaffolding up to 75ft, and able to work in inclement weather and harsh environments. All personnel must be capable of reading, (legible) writing, and conveying information in English. Task 2.0 Training The contractor is required to provide a syllabus and execute training to cover a variety of topics to include at a minimum: situational awareness, leadership training, social media awareness, note taking, mental health awareness, and other categories related to this type of work. Task 3.0 ClearancesThe Contractor shall maintain a Top-Secret Facility Clearance issued by DCSA until completion of the contract. Loss of facility clearance will result in termination of the contract for cause. All personnel submitted to work on task orders, including the Program Manager and Deputy Program Manager, shall hold a TS clearance and be submitted for a DOS Reciprocal Top-Secret Clearance. Task 4.0 Accounting All contractors shall have an accounting system in place to meet DCAA Compliance standards, which include, but are not limited to: Segregation of direct and indirect costs Cumulative-to-date direct costs by CLIN Segregation and identification of unallowable costs Total time

title: X-ray imaging detector system
description: SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory is operated by Stanford University for the Department of Energy. As a management and operating contractor, subcontracts awarded by the Laboratory are not Federal procurements, and are not directly subject to the Federal Acquisition Regulations in 48 CFR. Nonetheless, certain Federal laws, Executive Orders, and regulations may affect our DOE approved purchasing system, as required by statute, regulation, or contract terms and conditions. AMENDMENT 01 The following addendum is issued for Request for Quotation: 369006_X-Ray_Imaging_Detector_System. This amendment provides answers to supplier questions and clarifies the technical requirements and competition basis. This amendment must be acknowledged. Failure to acknowledge all amendments may make a proposal non-responsive. Suppliers shall confirm whether their previously submitted proposal remains unchanged. If the clarification results in a change, please submit a revised proposal. All other terms and conditions of the Request for Quotation remain unchanged. Supplier Questions and SLAC Responses 1. Is the detector intended for an industrial application or for research use, specifically X-ray diffraction? SLAC Response: The detector is intended for X-ray diffraction research. 2. Is this purchase replacing an existing detector? If yes, please provide the current detector model and original serial number so suppliers can confirm compatibility. SLAC Response: This purchase is not replacing an existing detector. However, part of the detector's purpose is to serve as a direct backup for LCLS, as needed, to reduce the risk of beamtime loss. The detector currently integrated for this application is the Varex XRD 4343CT-F22-C-000 Imaging Grade detector. 3. The solicitation states that the detector must be applicable for hard and high-energy X-ray diffraction greater than 20 keV. What operating energy range and shielding level are required for the intended application? SLAC Response: The required operating energy range is at least 20-100 kV. Shielding will be provided by the beamline. The detector window-to-sensor path must be non-metal. 4. Will SLAC consider an alternative detector with a 35 cm x 43 cm active area, rather than the stated minimum active area of 40 cm x 40 cm, if the remaining technical requirements are met? SLAC Response: No. Square geometry is required because of the diffraction-ring application, and the smaller detector dimension defines the usable area. The detector must also be a flat panel with a narrow depth of less than 10 cm due to space constraints, and the total weight must be less than 15 kg. 5. Will SLAC consider equivalent products from alternative manufacturers, provided the proposed product meets all technical requirements? SLAC Response: Not considered 6. Is the procurement a Small Business Set-Aside, or is it full and open competition? SLAC Response: This procurement is open competition and is not a Small Business Set-Aside. The follow has been attached for you to complete and review: Requested for Quote: Please provide a price and lead time quotation by 10/30/2026. Technical Evaluation Factors Listed Below: Applicable for hard and high-energy X-ray diffraction greater than 20 keV. Minimum active area of 40 cm x 40 cm. 150 micron pixel size. Amorphous silicon sensor. Flat-panel detector configuration. Required item(s) are listed below: XRD 4343CT-F22-C-000 Imaging Grade digital X-ray detector Quantity: 1 EA XRD-EPS 215W power supply Quantity: 1 EA XRD-EP AC cable Quantity: 1 EA XRD-EPS-B2 DC cable, 50 ft / 15.25 m Quantity: 1 EA XRD-FGX extension cable, 50 ft / 15.25 m Quantity: 1 EA XRD FG(E) OPTO - PCIe Frame Grabber V4 Quantity: 1 EA XRD-FGX-PC connection cable, 25 ft / 7.6 m Quantity: 1 EA Quote is for product only; no on-site services permitted. Source selection will be based on Lowest Priced Technically Acceptable Method and best Lead-Time. Please provide a price and lead time quotation by 10/16/2026. Send quote to Cheryl.stafford@slac.stanford.edu. Is there any room for additional discount such as for Academic, ICPT, GSA, or Government Institutions? Buy American Act Certification (BAA) applies to awards over $15,000 unit price. Representations & Certifications Rider is required. Once completed the Reps and Certs is valid for one year until renewal. If you have already completed one within the year please disregard. Otherwise, please complete and return. Please state whether duties or tariffs are included in or excluded from the quoted price. All subcontractors are required to register in the System for Award Management (www.sam.gov). If possible, please provide a link to your webpage for published price list to substantiate for the prices quoted. The resulting purchase order will be issued on a fixed price basis. SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory Terms and Conditions for Fixed Price Commercial Supplies and Services (Rev. August 2023) as well as the SLAC General Terms and Conditions Supplemental Rider (Aug2026_Rev1) will be made a part of the resulting order. Please markup terms and conditions if you wish to negotiate. No mark ups mean that you accept SLAC Terms and Conditions. Payment Terms will be NET-30 Domestic Suppliers - Freight terms will be FOB Destination Prepaid and Add. Foreign Supplier - Shipment will be made CIP SLAC, Menlo Park, and Duty Unpaid. In accordance with FAR 11.104 - Use of brand name or equal purchase descriptions. Software/Hardware/Services: This procurement is for new equipment ONLY, unless otherwise specifically stated. No remanufactured or "gray market" items are acceptable. All equipment must be covered by the manufacturer's warranty. � Vendor shall be an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), an OEM authorized dealer, an authorized distributor, or an authorized reseller for the proposed equipment/system such that OEM warranty and service are provided and maintained by the OEM. All software licensing, warranty, and service associated with the equipment/system shall be in accordance with the OEM terms and conditions � Offerors are required to submit documentation from the manufacturer stating that they are an authorized distributor for the specific items being procured. Note: Maintenance Renewals - The performance period for maintenance renewals, (software licenses, services, etc.), must begin on or after the date of contract award. The performance period cannot be back dated. If reinstatement fees are required, they must be listed on separate line items. Lowest Price Technically Acceptable � Factor 1 � Price. Quotes will be evaluated to determine if the price is fair, and reasonable in accordance with FAR 12.209 (Commercial Item Determination of Price Reasonableness) and in conjunction with FAR 13.106-3 (Simplified Acquisition Procedures Award and Documentation). Quotations shall include a price for each Contract Line Item Number (CLIN). Factor 2 � Technical. The Government will evaluate the quoter�s capabilities to provide supplies/services in accordance with (IAW) the Solicitation. Offers will be ranked lowest to highest according to price. A price analysis will be conducted to determine whether the lowest price will result from a single award or multiple awards. Based on the price analysis, the lowest price offer or multiple offers, will be forwarded to the requiring activity for technical evaluation. Offer(s), in accordance with the specifications, will be deemed either technically acceptable or technically unacceptable. If the lowest price offer or offers is found technically acceptable and the pricing determined fair and reasonable by the Contracting Officer, evaluation will be deemed complete and award will be made based on the lowest price offer(s) Table A-1. title: Request for Information on Combat Boot Sock
description: SYNOPSIS: This Sources Sought Announcement is to assist the U.S. Marine Corps Portfolio Acquisition Executive Marine Corps (PAE MC) to identify potential sources to provide a Combat Boot Sock. The goal is to provide warfighting capability and mission support in various environments by enhancing foot comfort, durability, and performance for military personnel. The Government requests that responses be submitted electronically to mary.k.prebensen.civ@army.mil and harvey.walker1@usmc.mil by October 30, 2026 by 5 PM EST. Background: Program Manager Combat Support Systems (PM CSS) is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of manufacturing a high-performance combat boot sock that meets the requirements of Purchase Description MC-PD-24-003. The sock is intended for use with the applicable standard-issue combat boots identified in the purchase description. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued for market-research and planning purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation, request for proposal, or commitment by the Government to procure any product or service. Description: The Marine Corps is seeking sources capable of manufacturing a durable, reliable combat boot sock designed to provide comfort, protection, and performance during demanding operational use. The sock shall meet the following Salient Characteristics specified in Purchase Description MC-PD-24-003, including, but not limited to, the following key requirements: Sock shall feature an over-the-calf length with cushioning comfort to protect the wearer from hot spots, pressure points, and blisters when wearing combat boots, and they provide graduated compression to promote blood flow from the foot with a non-slip top cuff opening. The foot of each sock includes contouring for the sock to stay in place without bunching, arch support, a gore heel and toe for improved fit, and nylon reinforcement at the heel and toe for durability. A seamless toe closure or a recessed closure with equivalent low profile is used for comfort and durability. Basic Materials. The sock shall contain wool a minimum of 52% wool (no coarser than US 60s (25 microns or finer)), a minimum of 20% nylon, and a minimum of 1% spandex and shall not contain cotton or rayon fiber. Shade. Shall be in accordance with section 3.3 of the Purchase Description Visual shade matching. Shall be in accordance with section 3.4 of the Purchase Description The finished socks shall conform to the requirements specified in table II when tested as specified. **Please refer to Table II. Sock performance requirement** Deliverables: This is a Sources Sought Announcement / RFI to identify potential sources. Based on responses, the Government may plan for a future acquisition. Interested parties should demonstrate their capability to produce socks meeting the above requirements. The Government may request samples for future evaluation. Submission Instructions: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY. This is not a solicitation, and no contract will be awarded from this announcement. Responses are for information and planning purposes only. This Sources Sought Announcement does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. It is subject to change and is not binding on the Government. Further, unsolicited proposals will not be accepted. Funding is not available at this time. The United States Marine Corps has not made a commitment to procure any of the items/services discussed, and release of this Sources Sought Announcement should not be construed as such a commitment or as authorization to incur cost for which reimbursement would be required or sought. Response to this Sources Sought Announcement is voluntary and no reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this and any follow-on information requests. All submissions become Government property and will not be returned. Not responding to this Sources Sought Announcement does not preclude participation in any future RFP if any is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized in the SAM.gov website. It is the responsibility of the potential responders to monitor this site for additional information pertaining to this subject. RESPONSES: Interested parties may identify their interest and capability by sending responses regarding this requirement to PAE MC via e-mail ONLY to harvey.walker1@usmc.mil no later than October 30, 2026 by 5:00 p.m. EST. The U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative cost incurred in response to this notice. All costs associated with responding to this Notice will be solely at the expense of the interested party. Please provide business size (indicate your socioeconomic status), applicable NAICS code, and CAGE code. If you hold a GSA Federal Supply Schedule contract, please identify your contract number. QUESTIONS: Any questions for clarification may be emailed to harvey.walker1@usmc.mil no later than October 26, 2026 by 5:00 p.m. EST. Verbal questions will NOT be accepted. Questions shall NOT contain proprietary or classified information. An unattributed list of questions and answers will be published at the same web location of this Sources Sought Announcement. **Amendment 0001 - attachment uploaded to answer questions**

title: Kytkinlaitteiden erikoiskunnossapito 2027-2029
description: Kytkinlaitteiden erikoiskunnossapito 2027-2029 Kytkinlaitteiden erikoiskunnossapito 2027-2029 (optiovuodet 2030-2032) Kytkinlaitteiden erikoiskunnossapitopalveluiden puitesopimuksien kilpailutus vuosiksi 2027–2029 + optiovuodet 2030–2032. Optiovuodet voidaan lunastaa erikseen vuosi kerrallaan, tai kerralla 3 vuotta. Hankinta tehdään julkisena puitejärjestelyhankintana neuvottelumenettelyä käyttäen. Hankinnan tavoitteena on, että pienet työt voidaan tilata tilaajan harkinnan mukaan suoraan tietyltä toimittajalta perustuen muun muassa toimittajan osaamisen, resursseihin sekä yleiseen hintatasoon. Puitejärjestely sisältää mm. seuraavat palvelut: - GIS-kojeistojen huollot ja viankorjaukset sekä -selvitykset. - 400 kV erottavien katkaisijoiden käytönaikaiset tarkastushuollot. - Katkaisijoiden avaavat huollot, modifioinnit tai perushuollot, viankorjaukset ja - selvitykset. - Erottimien modifioinnit, viankorjaukset ja -selvitykset. - Kytkinlaitteisiin liittyvät asiantuntijapalvelut ja konsultaatiot, kuten uusien kunnossapitoeritelmien kehitys Tilaajan kanssa. Joillekin yllä mainituista palveluista tullaan asettamaan osaamisen minimivaatimukset. Osaamisen kriteerit sekä puitejärjestelyyn sisältyvät palvelut määritellään tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä. Palveluita tilataan tarveperusteisesti. Pienet työt voidaan tilata suoraan puitejärjestelyssä mukana olevilta toimittajilta tilaajan harkinnan perusteella. Suuremmat kunnossapitotyöt voidaan kilpailuttaa niiden puitejärjestelyssä olevien toimittajien kesken, joiden osaamisen kriiterit täyttyvät. Toimittaja voi osallistua puitejärjestelyyn, vaikka ei pystyisi tarjoamaan kaikkia yllä mainittuja palveluita tai täyttämään yksittäiseen palveluun liittyviä osaamisen kriteereitä .,

title: Finland – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Circulating Fluidised Bed (CFB) reactor and Heat Recovery Steam Generator (HRSG) pilot plant
description: Detailed engineering, manufacturing, delivery, installation, testing and commissioning of a 100 kWth circulating fluidized bed (CFB) pilot plant and an attached heat recovery steam generator (HRSG). The CFB shall be capable of combustion, gasification and other reaction modes using different feedstocks and the process gases specified in the technical documentation. The HRSG, located downstream of the CFB, shall operate as a once-through unit for steam generation and hot-gas cooling. The HRSG shall be designed and manufactured in accordance with PED 2014/68/EU using Module G conformity assessment. Detailed technical requirements, operating conditions, preliminary designs and CAD models are provided in the technical annexes of the Call for Tender. The selected tenderer may display its company name on the delivered CFB and HRSG test rigs.

description: Το αντικείμενο της δημόσιας σύμβασης αφορά την κατασκευή κτιριακών υποδομών και τη διαμόρφωση του περιβάλλοντος χώρου του Εκπαιδευτικού Αστρονομικού Πάρκου Όρλιακα (ΕΑΠΟ). Ο τόπος εκτέλεσης του έργου είναι γήπεδο έκτασης 28 στρεμμάτων, στο 6ο χιλιόμετρο της επαρχιακής οδού Ζιάκα–Περιβολίου, σε ύψωμα «Ράχη Κερασιάς» της οροσειράς Όρλιακα, στην περιοχή Γρεβενών, σε υψόμετρο περίπου 1.450 μέτρων.Το έργο περιλαμβάνει την ανέγερση κτιριακού συγκροτήματος αποτελούμενου από έξι κτίρια, τα οποία θα εξυπηρετούν τις λειτουργικές ανάγκες του Πάρκου, καθώς και την κατασκευή δεξαμενής ύδρευσης, συστήματος αποχέτευσης με διάταξη βόθρων, περίφραξης και διαμόρφωσης του περιβάλλοντος χώρου, συμπεριλαμβανομένων χώρων στάθμευσης.Οι απαιτούμενες οικοδομικές και ηλεκτρομηχανολογικές εργασίες περιγράφονται αναλυτικά στα τεύχη της διακήρυξης.

description: Предметът на обществената поръчка включва изработка и доставка на холограмни стикери по обособени позиции, в частта по Обособена позиция 2 „Изработка и доставка на комплект „Знак и стикер за първоначален технически преглед на МПС“ - 2 000 000 бр. холографски стикера и 2 000 000 бр. знак със съответните холограмни реквизити. ​На основание чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП, във връзка с чл. 7 от ППЗОП, обособена позиция № 1 с предмет: „Изработка и доставка на холограмни стикери за служебните карти на служителите на МВР" - 60 000 бр., ще се възлага чрез директно възлагане, по реда на чл. 21​, ал. 6 от ЗОП, съобразно прогнозната й стойност от 75 180,00 евро без ДДС. Стойността на обособена позиция № 1 не надхвърля стойността от 79 998,77 евро без ДДС и 20 на сто от общата прогнозна стойност на поръчката, която е 5 995 180,00 евро без ДДС. Съгласно разпоредба на чл. 7, ал. 1 от ППЗОП, остатъчната стойност на поръчката е 5 920 000,00 евро без ДДС. В изпълнение на чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП, независимо от размера на остатъчната стойност на поръчката, тя се възлага по реда, приложим към общата прогнозна стойност на цялата поръчка. ​​​​​​​В настоящата обществена поръчка оферта се подава САМО по обособена позиция № 2 „Изработка и доставка на комплект „Знак и стикер за първоначален технически преглед на МПС“. ​​​​​​​Обособена позиция № 1 ще се възлага по реда на чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП.

title: France – Processing and clearing services – Fourniture de chèques emploi service universels (CESU), dématérialisés ou non, aux agents des ministères sociaux.
description: Dans le cadre de la politique conduite pour favoriser les services à la personne – Plan de développement des services à la personne LOI N° 2005-841 du 26 juillet 2005, les ministères sociaux ont mis en place, depuis septembre 2006 le chèque emploi service universel (CESU) préfinancé pour une partie de leurs agents, destinés notamment au paiement : • Du salaire net d'un salarié employé directement dans le cadre des services à la personne ; • De prestations de services à la personne fournies par des organismes agréés ; • Des structures d'accueil de jeunes enfants (crèches, garderies, centres de loisirs…) ; • De structures agréées, habilitées à effectuer, pour le compte de particuliers employeurs, l'ensemble des formalités liées à l'emploi d'un salarié à domicile (recrutement, gestion administrative du salarié, ...) ; • De prestations d'aide à domicile délivrées à ses ascendants par des salariés employés à domicile ou des organismes agréés, si ces ascendants sont bénéficiaires de l'allocation personnalisée d'autonomie (APA). Le CESU est un titre de paiement nominatif à montant prédéfini délivré par les ministères sociaux qui en assurent le financement intégral.

title: Greece – Plumbing materials – ΠΡΟΜΗΘΕΙΑ ΥΔΡΑΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ 2027-2030
description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η προμήθεια υδραυλικών υλικών, τα οποία θα χρησιμοποιηθούν από τις υπηρεσίες του Δήμου την τετραετία 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030, ήτοι μέχρι 31/12/2030 ή έως την εξάντληση του ποσού και των ποσοτήτων, εφόσον η προμήθεια εκτελεστεί σε ποσοστό 100%. Η δαπάνη για την παρούσα προμήθεια προϋπολογίζεται να ανέλθει στις 1.189.281,57€, συμπεριλαμβανομένου ΦΠΑ (Προϋπολογισμός χωρίς ΦΠΑ 959.098,04€ + ΦΠΑ 24% 230.183,53€ = 1.189.281,57€) και θα καλυφθεί από τον προϋπολογισμό των οικονομικών ετών 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030 του Δήμου Φυλής ως πολυετής δαπάνη (Ποσό απορρόφησης ανά έτος 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030 = 297.320,39€). Η παρούσα δαπάνη θα βαρύνει τον Α.Λ.Ε. 025.2410106001. Οι τιμές μονάδας για κάθε είδος που αναγράφονται στον ενδεικτικό προϋπολογισμό της παρούσας μελέτης, εκτιμήθηκαν με βάση την έρευνα αγοράς από το ελεύθερο εμπόριο και λαμβάνοντας υπόψιν και σχετικούς διαγωνισμούς που έχει διεξάγει ο δήμος τα προηγούμενα έτη. Η αναγκαιότητα της εν λόγω σύμβασης προκύπτει από τις αυξημένες ανάγκες των υπηρεσιών του δήμου για την ως άνω προμήθεια, μετά και την κατάργηση των νομικών προσώπων των Ο.Τ.Α. (Νόμος 5056/2023, ΦΕΚ Α 163/6.10.2023). Οι ποσότητες της προηγούμενης υπογραφείσας σχετικής σύμβασης για τα έτη 2025-2026 έχουν σχεδόν εξαντληθεί ήδη με αποτέλεσμα την άμεση ολοκλήρωση της σύμβασης αυτής. Έτσι δημιουργήθηκε η αναγκαιότητα πρόσθετων ποσοτήτων για τα έτη 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030 που αναμένεται να καλυφθεί με την εν λόγω διαδικασία. Οι ποσότητες των υδραυλικών υλικών που αναφέρονται στον Πίνακα Ενδεικτικού Προϋπολογισμού της παρούσας μελέτης είναι αμιγώς ενδεικτικές και όχι δεσμευτικές για την αναθέτουσα αρχή. Η εκτέλεση της προμήθειας και η ανάλωση των ειδών θα πραγματοποιούνται τμηματικά, ανάλογα με τις πραγματικές ανάγκες και κατόπιν παραγγελιών των αρμόδιων υπηρεσιών του Δήμου Φυλής, οι οποίες θα εξαρτώνται από τις εκάστοτε παρουσιαζόμενες ανάγκες συντήρησης και αποκατάστασης των δικτύων. Ο Δήμος Φυλής διατηρεί το δικαίωμα να μην εξαντλήσει το σύνολο των ενδεικτικών ποσοτήτων ή του προϋπολογισμού κατά τη διάρκεια της τετραετούς σύμβασης. Οι τελικές ποσότητες των υλικών που θα παραγγελθούν ενδέχεται να είναι μικρότερες των προϋπολογισθέντων, ανάλογα με τις πραγματικές ανάγκες των αρμόδιων υπηρεσιών. Ο ανάδοχος δεν διατηρεί καμία αξίωση για αποζημίωση ή διαφυγόντα κέρδη σε περίπτωση που η απορρόφηση υπολείπεται του αρχικού ενδεικτικού προϋπολογισμού. Η προμήθεια κατατάσσεται στους Κωδικούς Κοινού Λεξιλογίου δημοσίων συμβάσεων (CPV): 44115210-4 Υλικά υδραυλικών εγκαταστάσεων Η εκτέλεση της παραπάνω προμήθειας θα γίνει με την διενέργεια δημόσιου ηλεκτρονικού διαγωνισμού άνω των ορίων και με κριτήριο κατακύρωσης την πλέον συμφέρουσα από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, βάσει τιμής σύμφωνα με τις διατάξεις του Ν.4412/2016 όπως τροποποιήθηκαν και ισχύουν, για το σύνολο των προς προμήθεια ειδών. Η παρούσα προμήθεια δεν υποδιαιρείται σε τμήματα. Προσφορές υποβάλλονται για το σύνολο των παραπάνω ειδών. Η διάρκεια υλοποίησης της προμήθειας ορίζεται από την υπογραφή της σύμβασης για την τετραετία 2027, 2028, 2029 και 2030, ήτοι μέχρι 31/12/2030 ή έως την εξάντληση του ποσού και των ποσοτήτων,εφόσον η προμήθεια εκτελεστεί σε ποσοστό 100%. Αναλυτική περιγραφή του φυσικού και οικονομικού αντικειμένου της σύμβασης δίδεται στην υπ’ αριθμ. 160/2026 μελέτη της υπηρεσίας. Η σύμβαση μπορεί να τροποποιείται κατά τη διάρκειά της, χωρίς να απαιτείται νέα διαδικασία σύναψης σύμβασης, μόνο σύμφωνα με τους όρους και τις προϋποθέσεις του άρθρου 132 του ν. 4412/2016 και κατόπιν γνωμοδότησης της καθ’ ύλην αρμόδιας υπηρεσίας ή άλλως της υπηρεσίας η οποία ορίζεται με απόφαση της Α.Α. Η σύμβαση θα ανατεθεί με το κριτήριο της πλέον συμφέρουσας από οικονομική άποψη προσφοράς, βάσει της τιμής.

title: IT kehittämisen ja ylläpidon palvelut ajalle 1.11.2022 (tavoite) - 31.10.2026
description: Tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS) kohteena on IT kehittämisen ja ylläpidon palvelut Turun kaupungin asiakkaille. DPS:n kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä, erityisesti liitteessä "Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohde". Tilaaja täsmentää ja kuvaa hankintatarpeensa tarkemmin dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisen kilpailutuksen tarjouspyynnöissään. DPS:ään voi jättää osallistumishakemuksia koko sen keston ajan. Kaikki hakijoille asetetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät hakijat hyväksytään osallistumaan DPS:ssään. Hankinnat tehdään DPS:n sisällä erillisillä tarjouspyynnöillä. DPS:n kohteena on IT-asiantuntijatyö. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohteeseen kuuluvat seuraavat palvelut: 1) IT kehittämisen ja ylläpidon palvelut sekä lisenssit 2) IT-omaisuuden hallinta 3) Tietoturva ja tietosuoja 4) Määrittely ja jatkuvuussuunnittelu 5) Sovellus- ja ohjelmistokehitys ja ylläpito 6) Alustapalvelut ja lisenssit 7) Toteutuksen arkkitehtuuri DPS:n keston aikana kaikki kiinnostuneet ehdokkaat voivat tehdä siihen osallistumishakemuksen. Turun kaupungin asiantuntijat toteuttavat hankinnat DPS:ään hyväksyttyjen ehdokkaiden kesken DPS:n sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, jotka voivat ajoittua DPS:n koko hankintavaiheen ajalle. DPS:n hankintavaihe alkaa perustamisvaiheen jälkeen arviolta 15.11.2022 ja päättyy DPS:n voimassaoloajan päättyessä.

The U.S. Government currently occupies office and related space in a building under a lease in Towner, ND that will be expiring. The Government is considering alternative space if economically advantageous. In making this determination, the Government will consider, among other things, the availability of alternative space that potentially can satisfy the Government�s requirements, as well as costs likely to be incurred through relocating, such as physical move costs, replication of tenant improvements and telecommunication infrastructure, and non-productive agency downtime. If existing building, building name and address, and location of the available space within the Building, along with building site/ lot plans, interior layout drawings/pictures (with dimensions shown) reflecting the Space that is being offered. 2. description: USDA Forest Service � Fire & Aviation Management Industry Engagement Notice: Long-Term Fire Retardant Specification Revision Event Date: November 10, 2026 Event Time: Start time TBD. Attachments related to the engagement will also be emailed to registered attendees in advance. title: Udbud vedrørende anskaffelse af mobilt opdæmningsmateriel
description: Udbud vedrørende anskaffelse af mobilt opdæmningsmateriel Beskrivelse (dansk): Beredskabsstyrelsen ("BRS") ønsker sammen med landets 30 kommunale redningsberedskaber ("de Kommunale Beredskaber") at indgå en rammeaftale om anskaffelse af mobilt dæmningsmateriel i form af fritstående oversvømmelsesbarrierer. Anskaffelsen har primært til formål at understøtte BRS' og de Kommunale Beredskabers akutte håndtering af klimahændelser, herunder ved varsling om forhøjet vandstand fra bagland såvel som havvand, samt ved indsats i forbindelse med større brande. Det mobile dæmningsmateriel skal anvendes både selvstændigt i forbindelse med håndteringen af bl.a. klimahændelser, ligesom det skal indgå som supplement til BRS' og de Kommunale Beredskabers eksisterende opdæmningsmateriel. Materiellet skal kunne anvendes i flere forskellige indsatsscenarier. Det skal for det første kunne etableres hurtigt og fleksibelt over varierende strækninger ved ekstraordinære vandstandsstigninger, herunder ved akut indsats i baglandet, f.eks. ved søer og åer, samt ved kyster og havne. Det skal for det andet kunne benyttes til beskyttelse af enkeltobjekter, f.eks. kritisk infrastruktur. Det skal for det tredje kunne anvendes som vandreservoir i forbindelse med større brandindsatser, hvor vand anbringes i reservoiret, hvorfra én eller flere pumper fordeler vandet til indsatsområdet. Det mobile dæmningsmateriel skal have en primær højde svarende til højden på BRS' eksisterende og mest anvendte opdæmningsmateriel. Da de lokale beredskabers risikovurderinger og behov varierer, ønskes der herudover tilbudt opdæmningsmateriel i andre højder, som muliggør tilpasning til områder med behov for lavere eller højere opdæmning. Det er væsentligt, at materiellet tillader hurtig, let og effektiv transport, etablering og nedtagning, herunder at håndteringen kan ske med et minimum af ressourcer og på en arbejdsmiljømæssigt forsvarlig måde. Materiellet forudsættes at kunne benyttes flere gange. Materiellet vil blive oplagret på lager og transporteret til indsatsområderne via lastbil. Under indsættelse skal materiellet kunne håndteres ved håndkraft, herunder aflæsses, opsættes, nedtages og læsses, af et minimalt mandskab. Rammeaftalen har en varighed af 4 år fra underskrift.

title: Omsetning av fysiske kraftrettigheter og rådgivning og bistand til finansiell sikring
description: 1.1 Om oppdragsgiveren Ål Kraftverk KF innbyr til konkurranse om salg og optimering av kraftrettigheter, samt rådgivning og bistand til finansiell sikring. Ål Kraftverk KF er et heleid kommunalt foretak som er eid av Ål kommune. Foretaket ble opprettet i 1914 og forvalter de kommunale kraftrettighetene for Ål kommune, samt drifter Ylifossen kraftverk. De kommunale kraftrettighetene består av ca. 101 GWh konsesjonskraft, 80 GWh erstatningskraft og andelskraft fra Usta og Nes Kraftverk på 45-65 GWh. Kraftverket har også produksjon fra Ylifossen kraftverk på ca. 12. GWh. (I tillegg har Ål Kraftverk en andel i Lya kraftverk på 30 prosent som utgjør ca. 5. GWh, men denne er ikke omfattet av oppdraget.) Til sammen utgjør dette rettigheter og produksjon for Ål Kraftverk på ca. 245 GWh. 1.2 Omfanget av oppdraget Formålet med denne anskaffelsen er å inngå avtale om rådgivning og forvaltning av Ål Kraftverk KFs kraftrettigheter. Oppdraget omfatter å melde om uttak av kraft og selge kraften på Nord Pool til best mulige priser (optimering av brukstidsverdien i konsesjonskraften), rådgivning og bistand ved finansiell sikring av deler av kraftrettighetene. Oppdraget er nærmere spesifisert i punkt 2 nedenfor. Tilbudet er lagt ut ved elektronisk konkurransegjennomføring (KGV) og følger anskaffelsesforskriften del 2. 1.3 Kontraktens varighet og volum Kontraktenes varighet er 5 år. Oppstartsdato er 1. januar 2027. De samlede kraftrettighetene som omfattes av kontrakten er ca. 245 GWh per år. Kontrakten reguleres av kontraktsvilkårene som er vedlagt konkurransegrunnlaget og spesifikasjonene som kommer frem i konkurransegrunnlaget og i leverandørens tilbud. 2. Om leveransen Ål Kraftverk KF har følgende fysiske rettigheter som er omfattet av oppdraget Konsesjonskraft ca. 101 GWh Ylifossen kraftverk ca. 12 GWh Nes og Usta kraftverk: Erstatningskraft 80 GWh Nes og Usta kraftverk: Andelskraft 45–65 GWh Leveransen omfatter følgende elementer: a) Anmelding av konsesjonskraft og salg av andre kraftrettigheter. på Nord Pool. b) Rådgivning og bistand i forbindelse med finansiell sikring. Sikringen skjer bilateralt med finansinstitusjon som motpart. c) Månedlige rapporter som viser uttaket de enkelte timer og inntekter for det fysiske salget, og en oppstilling med oversikt over inntekter d) Oppgjør og fakturering Det er et overordnet krav til leveransen at den skal være transparent for Ål Kraftverk. Leverandøren skal i tilbudet beskrive gebyrstruktur, netting-effekter på Nord Pool og eventuelt andre økonomiske fordeler som kraftforvalter oppnår ved å få kraftvolumet til Ål Kraftverk i sin portefølje på Nord Pool. NB! Se også vedlagte konkurransegrunnlag

title: Germany – Landscaping work for gardens – Freianlagen Learning Hub // UTN
description: Auf dem zukünftigen Campus der Technischen Universität Nürnberg im neuen Stadtquartier Lichtenreuth ist die Errichtung eines „Learning Hub“ vorgesehen. Das Baugrundstück befindet sich am Rand des künftigen Universitätsgeländes entlang der bereits fertiggestellten Dr.-Luise-Herzberg-Straße sowie der geplanten Tramtrasse. Der Learning Hub soll als zentraler Lern-, Arbeits- und Aufenthaltsort innerhalb des Campusensembles dienen. Das Gebäude umfasst unter anderem eine Cafeteria, eine Bibliothek sowie Lern- und Seminarräume. Die zugehörigen Freianlagen ergänzen diese Nutzungen und sind als flexibel nutzbare Außenräume für Aufenthalt, Verweilen, Lernen und Austausch konzipiert. Hierzu sind unterschiedliche Aufenthalts- und Nutzungselemente sowie die erforderlichen Freianlagen- und Pflanzarbeiten vorgesehen. Gegenstand des Vergabeverfahrens sind die für die Herstellung der Freianlagen des Learning Hub erforderlichen Leistungen gemäß den Vergabeunterlagen und dem Leistungsverzeichnis. Die Ausführung der Freianlagen ist in enger zeitlicher und organisatorischer Abstimmung mit dem Baufortschritt des Learning Hub sowie den weiteren Baumaßnahmen auf dem Campusgelände durchzuführen. Sämtliche für die Aufnahme des Universitätsbetriebs erforderlichen Freianlagen, insbesondere befestigte Flächen, Wege, Aufenthaltsbereiche und sonstige für die sichere und bestimmungsgemäße Nutzung erforderliche Anlagen, sind rechtzeitig vor Beginn des Herbstsemesters 2027 vollständig herzustellen und nutzbar zu übergeben. Pflanzarbeiten können, soweit dies aufgrund fachlicher, vegetationsbedingter oder jahreszeitlicher Erfordernisse notwendig ist, auch nach Aufnahme des Universitätsbetriebs ausgeführt bzw. abgeschlossen werden. Die Durchführung dieser Arbeiten ist so zu organisieren, dass der laufende Universitätsbetrieb möglichst nicht beeinträchtigt und die sichere Nutzung der bereits fertiggestellten Freianlagen jederzeit gewährleistet wird. Die konkreten Ausführungs- und Fertigstellungsfristen ergeben sich aus den Vergabeunterlagen.

title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Open-House-Rabattverträge 2024-11
description: Die Krankenkassen (ob HEK und/ oder hkk am jeweiligen Los teilnehmen, ergibt sich aus der Bezeichnung des jeweiligen Loses) verfolgen das Ziel, mit allen geeigneten pharmazeutischen Unternehmern Rabattverträge nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V über die im jeweiligen Los genannten Wirkstoffe, Wirkstoffkombinationen bzw. Darreichungsformen, Wirkstärken oder Fertigarzneimittel zu schließen. Vertragsgegenständliche Arzneimittel sind - soweit der Vertrag keine Ausnahmen regelt - immer alle austauschbaren Fertigarzneimittel des Vertragspartners nach dem Rahmenvertrag über die Arzneimittelversorgung gemäß § 129 Abs. 2 SGB V. Die Krankenkassen sichern einzelnen Vertragspartnern keine Exklusivität zu. Der Vertrag endet spätestens am 31.10.2026 (evtl. Ausnahmen ergeben sich aus den Angaben beim entsprechenden Los), unabhängig vom Datum des Vertragsschlusses. title: Germany – Building construction work – Neuanmietung Polizeidienstgebäude Kempen
description: Neuanmietung einer Liegenschaft für das Polizeidienstgebäude Kempen durch die Kreispolizeibehörde Viersen. Der Auftragnehmer muss hierzu ein Grundstück im festgelegten Auswahlgebiet in Kempen anbieten, auf dem er das neue Polizeidienstgebäude planen, errichten bzw. herrichten und an den Auftraggeber vermieten wird. Auftragsgegenstand ist der Abschluss eines Mietvertrags mit Bauverpflichtung über die Errichtung bzw. Herrichtung einer neuen Liegenschaft für die Kreispolizeibehörde Viersen.

title: Luxembourg – Statistical services – LUCAS (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey) 2027
description: The subject of this call for tenders is the provision of services to support and implement the LUCAS (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey) 2027.
